newsitem.title: USA: Dow index ends up 84 points in another wild session.
newsitem.headline: Dow index ends up 84 points in another wild session.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average ended with a gain of more than 84 points Wednesday as the market's volatility prompted investors to seek the relative safety of big-name blue-chip stocks.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow was up 84.66 points at 6,740.74. But in the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on heavy volume of 499 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
